observations: Two separate sewing machine stands are shown in the photos.
The stands have ornate black cast iron frames with treadle wheels.
One stand has a blue painted top surface with a wavy pattern.
The other stand has a brown wood-grain patterned top surface.
Both stands have a metal foot pedal grate and a rectangular opening for the sewing head.
The stands are placed on cracked concrete in an outdoor setting.
No sewing machine heads, motors, or accessories are visible in the photos.

claims.evidence: The items shown in the photos are the base frames for sewing machines.
This is a price claim that cannot be verified from the photos.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.
